digest.component_or_area: wall-clock assert linting / DET code-review criterion
propositions: Upper-bound wall-clock assertions in tests cause CI flake under runner contention and must be detected and escaped via hang-guard marker or skipif-CI perf-lane guard.
Detector must block new unescaped upper-bound asserts in tests/** with teaching message naming both escape methods; bare @pytest.mark.benchmark without skipif-CI does not escape.
test_config_perf.py:201 must migrate to spy cfg._ordered_layers (miss-path load_config behavior) with regression-detection companion test.
test_enrich_drain.py:261 must migrate to count pending_enrichment calls and zero drain spawns with regression-detection companion test.
Remaining 9 in-scope sites must carry reasoned hang-guard markers; detector run must be clean on tree.
Detector unit tests must cover fire cases, both escape methods, lower-bound exclusion, and self-exclusion via EXCLUDED_FILES.
